verdict.rationale: Base44 supports backend logic via its SDK/CLI (entities, CRUD, custom backend code) and has documented integrations for AI services (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) and third-party tools (Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Notion, HubSpot, Wix) plus built-in auth/login providers, but there is no explicit documentation of dedicated payment processing or transactional email integrations comparable to Stripe/SendGrid-style setup from the builder. missing for 10: explicit payments integration (e.g. Stripe) docs, explicit transactional email sending integration, hands-on confirmation that server-side custom functions can call these third-party services from the builder UI.
